summary: Enhance your assertiveness and boost your confidence with our comprehensive training course. Unlock your potential and communicate effectively.
lede: Assertiveness training helps professionals communicate their views, set boundaries, and handle workplace conversations constructively. Designed for people with workplace experience, it develops practical ways to make clear requests, give feedback using the SBI model, and respond to disagreement without escalating conflict. Learners also practise preparing conversations with the DESC script and planning contributions to meetings.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to communicate their views, expectations, and boundaries clearly while preserving working relationships. It suits foundation to intermediate learners with workplace experience and a willingness to practise realistic conversations. Assertiveness skills training is designed for:
modules: Confidence Action Plan and Progress Reporting
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. You should have basic workplace experience and bring two or three communication situations you want to handle more effectively, such as setting a boundary, giving feedback, making a request, or responding to disagreement. Coding is not required. Advanced communication concepts receive conceptual and operational treatment, while the DESC script, SBI feedback model, boundary statements, and action planning receive hands-on practice.
